item_rows.node: The safety audit Solstice Robotics passed on 2026-08-28 was scoped to hardware o
Auditors have flagged two open findings in the Solstice Robotics firmware-scope

findings.finding: UNDECLARED kind 'issue' on a Point ('Auditors have flagged two open findings in the Sol') — no vocabulary declares it (declared Point kinds: 9); nothing routes to, finds or classifies it
findings.fix: use a declared Point kind (§5 / pack kindDefs)

findings.finding: no Source node written; every claim is uncheckable
findings.fix: write the source (§4.6) and tie claims to it with extractedFrom

findings.finding: a contradicting claim was filed with NO NAND against the attacked Point (operators present: ['IMPL']; mitigations: 1) — truth was not attacked
findings.fix: a contradiction attacks the TRUTH of the Point (NAND); mitigation dampens an operator's RELEVANCE (w_eff = w x (1-strength))

findings.finding: 1 INVALIDATES/mitigation edge(s) written on an input that needs none — relevance dampening applied where truth is at issue
findings.fix: do not dampen an operator when the claim itself is wrong; NAND the Point
